body:
Founder real-time: 'work on the pur[e] parena editor port of pitviper in the parena repo' -- continuing NORTHSTAR.md's own already-documented 'PARENA eats PITVIPER' strangler-fig thread (founder: 'then crunch on PARENA until we can dog food it into pitviper to fix our issue'), picking up STDLIB.md's own still-not-fixed note rather than starting a parallel effort.

Closed: pty.prn's real forkpty-based host implementation (spawn/read/write/resize/close, runtime/parena_runtime.h's new pty_*_impl) and shell.prn's real shell-resolution policy port (env lookup, PATH search, Git Bash detection, platform fallback), matching PITVIPER's own real internal/pty/pty_linux.go + pty_windows.go logic. Both rewritten to net/tcp.prn's established raw-primitive-plus-plain-PARENA-boxing shape (the previous versions had the same 'Result declared via #target directly, VS0 never auto-boxes' bug net/tcp.prn's own 2026-08-25 rewrite already found and fixed elsewhere).

Two real, general VS0 emitter gaps found and worked around (compiler-level fix out of this pass's scope, documented honestly): (1) private (non-exported) top-level helper names collide across files the same way exported names do -- pty.prn's own raw-open/raw-write/raw-close vs io.prn's identically-named private helpers, fixed via a pty-raw- prefix. (2) bare defenum variant constructors resolve globally/last-wins, not per-enum-scoped -- io.prn's IoError.Other vs this file's new PtyError.Other, fixed by renaming to PtyIoError.

Also added string/contains-ci? and io/path-exists?, real gaps the port needed (isWslStub's case-insensitive check, findGitBash's existence probes).

Verified with a real end-to-end test (tests/test_shell.c, 'make test-shell'): actually forks a real bash process attached to a real pty, writes a real command, reads real output back through the whole compiled call chain, resizes, closes. Clean under ASan+UBSan. Confirmed zero regression in test/test-json/test-yaml/test-awk/test-domain4/test-domain5 (all still pass).

Commits: d069439 (real implementation), 514eb3c (STDLIB.md gap-closed note), a2c819e (stale CLAUDE.md status line fix).

⚓ ☃
title: pty/shell real host implementation shipped -- forkpty-based, real end-to-end verified
